metadata.description: Which platforms still sell unlimited Seedance 2.5? Compare unlimited days, clip caps, prices and expired offers, checked against each provider's own terms.

hero.label: Plan comparison
hero.title: Seedance 2.5 unlimited plans: costs and limits
hero.description: Compare the time window, upfront payment and output limits before choosing a plan. This snapshot covers Topview and Creaa’s public offers, not every provider.
hero.verdict: SeedanceAI.dev does not sell an unlimited plan. This workspace uses credits and shows the exact charge before each generation. The table below covers the platforms that do advertise unlimited access.
hero.source_note: Public pricing and terms checked on October 12, 2026. No purchase, queue-speed or generation test was performed. Offers can change; confirm the selected configuration at checkout. No affiliate links.

callout.title: What unlimited actually buys
callout.text: These offers remove per-task credit charges only for eligible manual website jobs. Queues and fair-use restrictions still apply; API, MCP and automation are excluded. [Topview terms](https://www.topview.ai/pricing) · [Creaa payment terms](https://creaa.ai/payment-terms.html).

sections.title: A credit-based option on SeedanceAI.dev
paragraphs: This site does not sell unlimited access. A 5s 480p Seedance 2.5 task uses 30 credits. The smallest pack is $9.90 for 150 credits: five such videos, about $1.98 each if all credits are used. This is a pack purchase, not individual-video checkout.
[Load a real 5-second sample](/ai-video-generator?sample=product-25#seedance-generator) or [calculate your own budget](/pricing#video-budget).

steps.title: Check the full commitment
steps.description: Compare the annual or monthly total, seats, renewal terms, unused credits and benefit dates.

steps.title: Test queue and usable output
steps.description: A short benefit window is only useful if the queue and output quality fit your deadline. Include retries in the budget.

steps.title: Recheck before purchase
steps.description: Save the checkout terms and selected tier. A headline or old launch promotion is not proof of today’s entitlement.

faqs.question: Is Seedance 2.5 unlimited here?
faqs.answer: No. This workspace charges the visible credit cost for each task. The comparison describes other providers’ offers.

faqs.question: Does unlimited mean instant generation?
faqs.answer: No. Check queues, concurrency, fair use, clip length and the benefit window. The label alone says nothing about how many usable videos you can finish by a deadline.

faqs.question: Can I use an unlimited plan through an API?
faqs.answer: The reviewed Topview and Creaa unlimited benefits exclude API and automated access. Separate API billing and account terms apply.

faqs.question: Which price should I compare?
faqs.answer: Compare the full upfront charge for the selected tier, including required seats and taxes. Then compare the allowed tasks, time window, and likely retries.
